name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd
title: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd - 542830 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: IRCTC FY26 revenue grew 11.6% to Rs 5,475 cr total but PAT only ~6% as CSR and ECL one-offs hit Q4; management reiterates ~30% EBITDA margin aspiration with no capacity or supply-side signal.

triggers.label: Segment growth targets: catering ~15%, tourism ~20%, IT ~10%
triggers.quote: catering it will continue to maintain around 15%. And tourism we are eyeing to continue with around this year we are looking to 19% should continue to be around 20%.

triggers.label: Q4 margin 27% vs 30% ex one-offs
triggers.quote: If we deduct those exceptional items in this quarter, it will be around 30% only.

triggers.label: Payment aggregator licence by August 2026
triggers.quote: August is the deadline and I am happy to tell that we will be able to do it by that time.

guidance.quote: Yes, we are aspiring to maintain 30%.
revenue-wise primary growth I see in catering it will continue to maintain around 15%.
IT business is 7%. We want to increase the non -convenience fee.

guidance.value: Ambernath 2 to 3 lakh bottles/day; Danapur 1 to 2 lakh
guidance.quote: expansion of Ambernath from 2 lakh bottles per day to 3 lakh bottles. And similarly for Danapur Railway plant from 1 lakh to 2 lakh bottles.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we will maintain 30%. Now, if you go to the financial year, the margin comes to around 31.95%.

red_flags.quote: So, that is under litigation. So, I should not comment it down to now.

red_flags.quote: This is an exceptional item, you can say that.
